'''Geri''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] orphan who held a fascination for technology, and he became involved in a resistance group led by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Degan Cor]] that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Toprawa/Legends|Toprawa]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Geri served the rebels as a [[Technician/Legends|mech-tech]], and he constructed the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Candy (droid)|Candy]] to aid the resistance group, by combining the head of an [[RX-series pilot droid/Legends|RX-Series pilot droid]] with the body of a [[P2-series astromech droid]]. In about [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], Geri encountered the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Den Dhur]] and the droid [[I-5YQ]]&mdash;agents of the [[Whiplash]] resistance group&mdash;after they arrived at Cor's resistance base on business with the Toprawan rebels. Geri helped to repair several droids for use by I-5YQ, to replace the Whiplash agent's original [[5YQ-series protocol droid|5YQ-series]] chassis, which had became irreparably damaged during an encounter with Imperial forces.
